description:
Social Media Content Creator

Location: Remote or Hybrid in Draper, UT

Team: Corporate Marketing

Reports to: Director of Content

Compensation: $50–$80/hr, based on experience, 20 hrs/week

Role type: Part-time independent contractor (1099)

🚀 About Jump

Jump’s mission is to empower financial professionals and their clients to thrive in the age of AI. Our AI platform helps financial professionals automate the client meeting cycle and other workflows, turning meetings, emails, and documents into structured data, automated workflows, and compliance-ready outputs.

Jump leads its category in market share and customer satisfaction, serving leading financial services firms. We’re building the intelligence layer that powers the modern advisory firm—helping advisors save time, grow faster, and deliver better outcomes for their clients.

Jump’s team values are:

High Velocity: You are self-driven, use good judgment, and deliver high-quality work at speed.

World Class: You demonstrate excellence, study what great looks like, continuously learn, and raise the bar for the team.

Direct + Kind + No Drama: You communicate directly and openly, act with and assume best intent, and handle conflict productively.

💼 About the Role

Jump is looking for a Social Media Strategist and Content Creator to manage our brand LinkedIn presence and help our executives increase their visibility as trusted voices on AI for advisors and financial professionals. This role is responsible for ensuring our brand and our leaders show up on LinkedIn consistently with credible, useful points of view delivered through written posts, graphics, and video.

In this role, you’ll manage Jump’s brand LinkedIn page and help our leaders post weekly, including periodic short-form thought leadership videos. You’ll partner closely with the Corporate Marketing team and Jump’s executives to grow Jump’s reach and credibility with advisors and financial professionals, while helping Jump stay the category leader, trusted and loved by customers.

This is a high-impact role for someone who is excited to shape how a fast-growing company and its leaders show up on social media. You should be expert at using AI tools to create high-quality work quickly, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help transform the advisor and client experience in financial services.

🛠️ What You’ll Do

  • Own Jump’s brand LinkedIn page: plan, write, and publish posts each weekday, respond to comments, and monitor mentions.

  • Drive executive thought leadership by interviewing Jump executives each month, building a voice guide for each executive, and helping them formulate weekly LinkedIn posts.

  • Partner with Jump’s executives to produce two vertical thought leadership videos per month, providing filming tips, talking points, and the final edit.

  • Build, improve, and scale our content pipeline using AI tools and workflows.

  • Use data, customer insights, and sound judgment to prioritize high-impact work.

  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders, share context proactively, and help the team move quickly.

  • Raise the bar for quality, speed, and customer impact in Jump’s LinkedIn presence.

🎯 What Success Looks Like

In the first 30-60 days

  • Build context on Jump’s product, customers, market, team, and operating cadence.

  • Align with your manager and key stakeholders on role expectations, priorities, and success metrics.

  • Establish strong working relationships with Jump’s executives and the Corporate Marketing team.

  • Create clarity around each executive’s voice, content themes, and review and approval process.

  • Own and deliver a consistent publishing cadence for the brand page and executives, including the first executive videos.

  • Identify early opportunities to add value in your area.

In the first 6–12 months

  • Drive measurable impact on follower growth, engagement, and reach for Jump’s brand page and executive LinkedIn profiles.

  • Improve how Jump operates in social media and executive content.

  • Help maintain a high bar for thought leadership across Jump’s brand and executive channels.

🙌 About You

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B social media and content marketing, including partnering with founders/executives to create thought leadership.

  • A strong track record of using AI tools to deliver high-quality work at speed.

  • Experience owning social media presence from strategy through execution.

  • Strong taste, judgment, structured thinking, and the ability to turn ambiguity into action.

  • Excellent communication skills and a direct, kind, low-drama working style.

  • High standards for your own work and a desire to continuously learn and improve.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-growing company where priorities can evolve quickly.

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, AI, or B2B SaaS.

✨ Nice to Haves

  • Experience working at a Series A–C company or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Familiarity with wealth management, asset management, banking, accounting, or insurance.

🧭 Interview Process

We try to keep the process flexible as we get to know you and you get to know us. That said, here are some steps you can more or less count on:

  1. [Screening Call] — This is the first opportunity to ensure alignment with the role scope, skillset, and compensation.

  2. [Hiring Manager Interview] — 30-45 minute conversation evaluating skills, experience, and fit

  3. [Trial Assignment & Evaluation Interview] — A paid trial assignment at your standard contracting rate. You’ll present your work to the hiring manager and other Jump marketers.

  4. Offer
